scope: Two uncommon-quality medieval shield concepts and twelve craft options. No runtime, loot, shop, or existing small-shield changes.
note: Generated checkerboard is baked into RGB. These are appearance concepts only; do not import as transparent sprites. Accepted designs still need isolated equip, inventory and drop views with real alpha and independent grip metadata.

prompts.prompt: Create a new alternate shield design by redesigning the supplied small wooden round shield reference. Reference role: existing game's material, lighting, and readable equipment-art standard, not an object to duplicate. Deliver ONE isolated shield only, a premium 3D PBR game equipment concept on a genuinely transparent RGBA background, square canvas, entire object within an 8% safe margin. Design: a compact practical medieval forged-steel parrying buckler called Forged Duelist Buckler (do NOT render any text). Circular outline, approximately 40 cm diameter in implied real scale. Replace the exposed timber face with cool matte tempered steel, a prominent rounded darkened steel central fist-protecting boss, four broad shallow structural ribs radiating into a smooth dish, a narrow rolled steel rim and a small number of functional rivets. Restrained broad hammer marks, worn edge highlights, clean readable continuous metal surfaces with sparse medium-scale wear, no fine noisy scratches. One small brown leather-wrapped center handle may be subtly glimpsed behind the near rim but no visible human hands. Common workmanship upgraded to good quality, practical and believable, not royal treasure. Predominantly frontal view with a mild three-quarter turn showing some rim thickness, upright stable orientation, large clear circular silhouette. Match the reference's soft upper-left light and grounded realistic game rendering, but make the material unmistakably steel. No gold, jewels, spikes, magical glow, runes, cartoon outlines, text, labels, frame, pedestal, floor, environment, cast shadow, or fake checkerboard. The shield must be a physically coherent single object, centered, not a collage.
